Bill.BriefDescription: Modifying the definition of manager under the state civil service law.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to modifying the definition of manager under thestate civil service law; amending RCW 41.06.022; and adding a newsection to chapter 41.06 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 41.06.022 and 2002 c 354 s 207 are each amended toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: For purposes of this chapter, "manager" means any employee who: (1) Formulates statewide policy or directs the work of an agency oragency subdivision; (2) Is responsible to administer one or more statewide policies orprograms of an agency ((or agency subdivision)); and (3) ((Manages, administers, and controls a local branch office ofan agency or agency subdivision, including the physical, financial, orpersonnel resources; (4) Has substantial responsibility in personnel administration,legislative relations, public information, or the preparation andadministration of budgets; or (5))) (a) Functionally is above the first level of supervision and p. 1 HB 1877exercises authority that is not merely routine or clerical in natureand requires the consistent use of independent judgment; or (b) Has substantial responsibility in personnel administration,legislative relations, public information, or the preparation andadministration of budgets. No employee who is a member of the Washington management servicemay be included in a collective bargaining unit established under RCW41.80.001 and 41.80.010 through 41.80.130.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 41.06 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: No more than seven percent of an agency's work force may be in theWashington management service. Employee positions separately funded bynonstate funds shall be excluded from this calculation.
